input.source: user-provided lawful dump, kept outside git

X0.note: User-provided external retail XEX hash and title identity verified; no game binary or assets are tracked

X1.note: SDK v0.10.0 is pinned; eighteen live-memory-derived function entries have focused static regressions. ReXGlue codegen and Linux AMD64 build now accept the 68-byte 0x82341198 dispatcher; its runtime execution and the broader PPC/import/lowering report remain open.

X2.note: The plugin-enabled Linux AMD64 probe verified the retail VdEnableRingBufferRPtrWriteBack call with physical address 0x17AF403C and block-size log2 6. The GPU worker advanced the big-endian readback at descriptor+0x3C through values 25, 49, and 73; exact-XEX helper 0x823B2920 reads that +0x3C field. Earlier pristine probes watched the distinct descriptor+0x00 word, object+0x2ABD predicate, current KTHREAD+0x58 and object+13432; helper 0x823B33A0 was not entered, and the timeout helper 0x823BA9C8 traps when object+13432 is null. The 2026-10-24 exact-XEX Linux/GDB follow-up confirms source-0 retail callback 0x823B37B8 and 3,231 writes toggling the watched predicate byte between 0x04 and 0x14 via 0x823A4E48/0x823A4908. This confirms guest execution and that the watched flag’s bit 2 is set during both observed states, not frontend progress. The event-write plugin change and isolated regression are recorded in Process 2 PR #2161, but the retained Linux runtime log has no per-packet EVENT_WRITE_SHD destination/value line; the early descriptor+0 watch saw no later changes and is not established as the event destination. The guest wait cause and menu progress therefore remain open. Before the latest controlled launches, 13 unused ReXGlue xenia_memory_* shared-memory objects were consuming 4.7 GiB of /dev/shm; they were unreferenced and removed, restoring 5.8 GiB for subsequent runs.

X3.note: Process 2 Linux evidence reports 1,828 retail PM4 packets, two guest swaps, 48 submitted retail point-list draws, and two Vulkan frame submissions. The exact-XEX Linux/GDB run recorded 161 draw submit entries and 161 accepted source-0/sample-0 Copy/Convert entries, but the retail 1280x720 A2B10G10R10 readback has zero non-black RGB pixels (FNV-1a B161DE6EEC272325). After clearing stale ReXGlue shared-memory objects, a fresh direct Linux run reproduced the same black retail readback. A separate magenta fragment-output diagnostic produced 518,400 non-black pixels (FNV-1a DA74DA070BC0D725), confirming the diagnostic raster/presenter/readback path; it is synthetic and not retail parity. Later 3-draw batches still fail the target/scissor match against PM4_XE_SWAP. Android readback is also black. Visible retail output and scene parity remain unverified. A 30-second Linux rerun with the exact host executable from the locked P1 evidence and Process 2 PR #2161 commit 8541089b produced byte-identical black readback (FNV-1a B161DE6EEC272325); repeated 3-draw batches still reject the target/scissor match. With that exact executable/plugin pair, a synthetic magenta control read back 518,400 nonblack pixels and had no 3-draw target/scissor rejection; this confirms diagnostic draw/presenter/readback coverage only, not retail parity.

X4.note: The user confirmed that the original game loading screen appeared during an earlier ReXGlue Xbox run, but its exact process/build hash was not recorded. In the current controlled Linux run, callbacks and retail Vulkan submissions occur but the readback is entirely black. Four loose-file probes for menu_background.xml failed. The big-endian index of PakFiles/Menu_Background.bff is verified: 57 bounded members include menu_background.sgx/.enx and textures, but no menu_background.xml. The misses do not prove a fatal VFS problem or show whether the game opens this archive. The main menu, visible retail frame, and offline race remain unverified.

X5.note: No SHIFT Xbox runtime execution on target architectures

X6.note: Source audit found a Vulkan 1.1 path but three optional feature bits are hard requirements; device feature probe and retail draw/present proof are pending
